purpose: Original painterly 360-degree sky panorama for Unity fairytale game Borrowed Light / 借光岛

referencesViewed.role: color and composition reference only; not an edit target
painterly atmosphere reference only; not an edit target

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready 360-degree equirectangular sky panorama texture for a Unity fairytale game, a brand new original raster image, not a screenshot or mockup.
Primary request: Paint an elegant hand-crafted nocturnal starfield with extremely refined cinematic animated-film background painting quality, softly tangible watercolor paper grain and subtle layered pigment. Output an ultra-wide 2:1 panorama, ideally 2048 x 1024 pixels, full bleed.
Scene/backdrop: Only deep space and abstract nebulous atmosphere, no foreground objects. Deep indigo and ink-blue base, with a restrained diagonal arch of soft teal-green and blue-violet nebula filaments flowing through the upper half of the panorama. Wisps have intricate soft edges, fine atmospheric transitions and depth, never bright photographic Milky Way. Sparse tiny warm-gold stars with varied brightness, mostly pinpoints and a very few delicate soft glints.
Composition/framing: Designed to wrap gently seamlessly around a skydome: left and right edges have matching dark indigo values and quiet continuous texture. Upper half contains the delicate nebula arc and visual richness; middle-to-lower half remains very calm and dark, with generous negative space, to support a bright miniature floating island and readable titles composited over it later. No hard horizon; lower edge remains space, darker than upper.
Lighting/mood: tranquil, intimate, poetic, luminous but low-contrast; sophisticated painterly atmosphere rather than neon fantasy.
Color palette: ink navy #06152e, midnight indigo #101e40, understated petrol teal #245256, muted periwinkle and rare amber-gold pinpoints. Beautiful tonal detail in darks.
Materials/textures: fine watercolor paper grain and artisanal translucent wash, consistently subtle at game scale.
Constraints: Absolutely no planet, moon, sun, horizon, mountain, landscape, island, building, figure, animal, symbol, constellation line, text, typography, logo, border, frame or watermark. Do not include a vignette or lens flare. Do not produce a UI, mockup, screenshot or diagram. This is a directly usable sky-only texture.

review.findings: Sky-only original painterly texture. Deep ink-blue lower half, teal and muted violet nebula across upper half, sparse warm star glints, subtle watercolor grain. No planets, moons, terrain, buildings, figures, typography, frame, or watermark. 2:1 output preserved without resizing or editing.
review.seamlessness: Prompted for softly continuous left/right edges. Not guaranteed pixel-perfect seamless; inspect wrap in the final skydome orientation.

modifications: Copied original built-in output unchanged; no image post-processing.
